description: This file defines a Flutter widget for the onboarding screen of a mobile application. It sets up UI elements including background, app bar, text, icons, and a button, managing onboarding completion state and navigation.

classes.name: OnboardingScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that presents the onboarding UI, including introductory text, feature highlights, and a call-to-action button that marks onboarding as completed and navigates to the login screen.

methods.name: _complete
methods.description: Asynchronously marks onboarding as completed in storage and navigates to the login screen.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the onboarding screen UI with themed styling, informational texts, icons, and a button to finish onboarding.
